caption_L1: Here a bar chart is labeled Forecast volume of rice produced in the European Union (EU 27) from 2015 to 2028 (in 1,000 tonnes). The x-axis measures Volume in thousand tonnes as linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1,500 while the y-axis shows Year along categorical scale with 2015 on one end and 2028* at the other.
caption_L2L3: The volume of rice produced by the EU peaked in 2016 and has since trended downward but expected to level off by 2022.
